mentions.h: Pam Davies - the running goes on!
mentions.note: born 30 May 1934 (née Evans); member about 12 years, previously Selsonia Ladies A.C; consistent Women's National performer; approaching 50 marathons; about 7th in 1953 Surrey C.C. Champs; ran for English Universities; Surrey County XC champion 1960, 1962/63 and a third time; 1st Southern Inter-counties 1962; 3rd Women's National 1963; won Women's A.A.A. mile 1963 in 5:10.8; mile best 5:02.3 (1963); taught 20 years at Battersea County; Women's National cross-country champion 1965 (Quinton), 1966 (Oxhey), 1967 (Witton Park, Blackburn), 1968 (Coventry); 2nd 1964 National at Bury; 5th 1967 and 3rd 1968 International Cross-Country; won four consecutive Nationals; 3:34 in Avon women-only marathon in London (1980); completed every London Marathon; marathon best 3:10:02
won W55 prize, Serpentine New Year's Day 10km 1992
donated magazines (with John Davies)
presented the Surrey women's individual cup; won the Surrey women's title seven times for Selsonia, six consecutively 1962-1967
